name: Holds Security Hub Finding
description: A Security Hub hub holds one of its active findings (hub -> finding): a finding securityhub:GetFindings returned, filtered to the run's own account, the hub's region and RecordState ACTIVE, read one severity label at a time and capped. Containment: the hub declares it in CONTAINMENT_EDGES. Its one surface per hub records the filter with no positive control and any truncation, so it is never complete and never nominates a retirement. Collected by the landing-zone reader's findings half (collectors/boto3_collector/findings.py, aws-core-tap#76).
